notes: #10: Merian workshop plate pasted into Gaston d’Orléans’s collection (assembled before 1660); BnF dates it only 17th century, so labeled about 1650. #11/#12 (Royer/Duflos ‘Vue de Dunkerque du côté de la mer’, dedicated to the duc de Penthièvre) and #13 (British School painting, low resolution) are 18th-century views with no firm date; a reviewer who can date #11 could use it for P2/P3. #16 (Place Jean Bart photochrom) is a good alternative to #15. #21 postcard dated only ‘before 1914’. #22/#23 are Dunkirk, New York (generating plant on Lake Erie), not this city.
